annotations.title: Read the complete public gene evidence profile

description: Read one source-qualified gene profile after resolve_gene and explicit candidate selection when needed. Returns the same immutable snapshot as the public Folklore gene page: overview, disease validity, dosage, mechanisms, transcripts and native assemblies, constraint, ClinVar summaries/consequences, expression, GWAS, phenotypes and protein/pathways. Preserve each assertion, source, coverage, count unit, null and limitation. Use get_gene_section for further pages. The immutable literature section is separate from live search_gene_literature. Gene constraint, GWAS association and gene-disease validity are not variant pathogenicity or patient diagnosis.

gene_id.description: Canonical HGNC gene_id returned by resolve_gene. Select an explicit candidate when resolution is ambiguous.
gene_id.title: Gene Id

snapshot_id.description: identity_snapshot_id returned by resolve_gene, or snapshot_id from the current gene profile. Restart resolution after snapshot_unavailable.
snapshot_id.title: Snapshot Id
